note: Runs placed by the lane from the strips (scripts/block-face/hand-place.ts): per pand the type, crown, storey count and cornice line read at full size on the 2023 strips. Lauriergracht is a canal of 1840-1880 cornice fronts with tall ground storeys, two or three upper storeys and white pedimented dormers; auto-place reads 3DBAG eaves at the roof back and dates restorations. The Opus strip review confirms or amends.
